segments.sn21.7:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.sn21.7:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti, poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya.
segments.sn21.7:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.sn21.7:2.3: “ko nu kho, bhikkhave, upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā”ti?
segments.sn21.7:2.4: “Āyasmā, bhante, visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti, poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā”ti.
segments.sn21.7:3.1: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ visākhaṃ pañcālaputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn21.7:3.2: “sādhu sādhu, visākha, sādhu kho tvaṃ, visākha, bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi … pe … atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāyā”ti.
segments.sn21.7:4.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.sn21.7:6.3: Subhāsitadhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo”ti.

lines: Sattame poriyā vācāyāti puravāsīnaṃ nagaramanussānaṃ vācāsadisāya aparihīnakkharapadāya madhuravācāya.
Anelagalāyāti yathā dandhamanussā mukhena kheḷaṃ gaḷantena vācaṃ bhāsanti, na evarūpāya, atha kho niddosāya visadavācāya.
Dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajoti navavidhalokuttaradhammo isīnaṃ dhajo nāmāti.
Sā pana dutavilambitakhalitavasena appasannalūkhatādidosarahitā hotīti āha “pura … pe … vācāyā”ti.
Catusaccassa pakāsakā, na kadāci saccavimuttāti āha “catusaccapariyāpannāyā”ti.
Tā hi cattāri saccāni paricchijja āpādenti paṭipādenti pavattenti.
